0.label: plaited_band_upper
0.description: A long band of multi-strand, grooved plait filling the upper third of the post face, above the figure.
0.iconography: The woven binding that encloses the figure from above; one half of an interlace–figure–interlace sequence.

1.label: plaited_band_lower
1.description: The matching plait band below the figure, cut off by the break at the foot of the post.
1.iconography: Lower half of the frame around the figure (see #0).

2.label: figure_with_raised_open_hands
2.description: In the middle of the post, under a frieze of hatched triangles, a frontal figure with a very wide crescent-shaped head, large lidded eyes, and both hands raised open at shoulder height.
2.iconography: Raised open hands are the Yoruba gesture of praise, greeting or supplication; on a post the figure also 'holds up' the frieze above like a caryatid. The oversized head stresses orí, the seat of destiny.

panel.title: Modakeke post: a figure with raised hands between plaited bands
panel.summary: A tall narrow post face from Modakeke carved as plait, figure, plait. The single figure has an enormous head and raises both open hands beneath a triangle frieze.

register_readings.reading: The figure with raised open hands under a triangle frieze.
Plait band, broken at the foot.

panel.composition: A–B–A: a single figure bound above and below by plait, framed by the frieze like a doorway.
panel.narrative: A lone figure praising or supporting, held within endless plait. On a Modakeke veranda post it would have greeted everyone entering the compound. Without its missing sections, it reads as a guardian or praise figure rather than part of a chronicle.
panel.hypotheses: Does not bear on 'chronicle'. The plait bands could be tested for counted crossings but nothing suggests they count.
cross_panel_links: Same plait-and-figure scheme as FoA_04-5578_panel_02 (same plate).
Raised-hand figures also appear on EBA-Div_00311_panel_00 and FoA_04-5578_panel_02.
uncertainties: The post is broken at both ends; there may have been more figures.
